headline: As of 2026-11-03: 59,253,117 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+8.9 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 59,253,117 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+8.9 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,743,160), California (6,481,962), Florida (5,575,052).
